data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of $167.2m (2015: favourable run off deviation of $12.3m) was experienced during the year in respect of various lines of business. The most significantly releases were within energy ($75.5m), reinsurance ($34.3m), casualty ($26.8m), financial lines ($24.7m) and marine ($21.1m). These were partially offset by increases in accident & health ($15.7m). This is mainly due to a reduction in the ultimate loss estimates.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a favorable prior-year run-off (release) of $167.2m in 2016, driven by reductions in ultimate loss estimates across multiple lines. The largest releases were in Energy, Reinsurance, Casualty, Financial Lines and Marine, partially offset by an increase in Accident & Health reserves. The movement is reported on a gross basis and materially improved the Syndicate's reserve position for prior years.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts reported in the native currency (USD) and converted to millions. Field names include 'gbp' per schema but values are USD millions. Prior year development taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note (explicit $167.2m favourable run-off) which is presented on a gross basis. Claims development triangle is present and includes an aggregated '2011 & Prior' column which has been excluded from the underwriting_years list. The report also notes a RITC into 2015 (RITC premium $2,053m) which can distort development patterns; however the prior-year movement used is the explicit movement note.
